scope: post-mission audit: auto-done scope + 6 scoped TUI files. Prior audit (hermux-perf, 95/100) covered 5 files but NOT ui.rs. This run adds ui.rs and finds new issues: Box::leak in modal render loop, scroll first-press no-op, dead statement in settings.

user_need_match.quote: auto-done: worker idle + 100% todos, claude exited without invoking worker-mark-done.sh
user_need_match.evidence: All three complaints are addressed by concrete, verified code. (1) TYPING LAG removed three ways: pane_cache (session.rs:117,266 pane_for — microsecond mutex+HashMap hit vs a 5-50ms daemon rmux.session RPC), connect_cached (session.rs:143 — one shared Arc<Rmux> socket instead of a fresh ~30-50ms connect per call), and a non-blocking ordered forwarder (main.rs hot-path Actions only do fwd_tx.send() on an unbounded channel and return instantly). The bounded event-drain loop (main.rs:657-667) processes all queued keys per tick instead of ~1 per 10ms; adaptive refresh (main.rs:608-615 — 30ms echo for 300ms after input, 80ms idle) keeps the echo tight. The single-FIFO forwarder (forwarder.rs:54) also fixes the prior out-of-order delivery (abc->acb). (2) SCROLL: position-aware mouse routing (input.rs scroll_active_panel_at: column>=30 scrolls the preview regardless of focus) plus a real clamp (app.rs:879-888 scroll_preview_up = saturating_add(lines).min(preview_max_scroll)) and scrollback-aware capture (app.rs:1016-1041 refresh_preview uses capture_pane_history(1000) when browsing history) — scroll stops at the top of real history, not an empty void. (3) PASTE: a multiline paste is forwarded as ONE bracketed-paste block — handle_paste -> Action::SendTextRawToSession -> ForwardMsg::Paste -> send_paste_raw (session.rs:498) which emits ESC[200~ ... ESC[201~ with NO trailing Enter, so embedded newlines no longer submit each line. 'Toutes les options' preserved: build clean, every existing send/capture method retains its stale-retry, no feature removed.
edge_cases_covered: fast typing keystroke ordering (single FIFO consumer)
space char rendered as the word 'space' avoided (routed as Key 'Space')
paste while scrolled-up re-glues to tail (scroll_preview_end on dispatch)
multibyte UTF-8 paste chunking respects char boundaries (no panic)
history scroll clamped to preview_max_scroll (no scroll into void)

falsifiable_tests.name: paste dispatch chain trace (CLAIM vs REALITY of 'bracketed paste')
falsifiable_tests.hypothesis: If paste were forwarded as raw text (no bracketed markers), embedded newlines would submit each line and the user's bug would persist.
falsifiable_tests.expected: input paste -> ForwardMsg::Paste -> send_paste_raw which wraps in ESC[200~/ESC[201~ with no Enter
falsifiable_tests.actual: main.rs maps Action::SendTextRawToSession -> ForwardMsg::Paste; forwarder.rs:97 ForwardMsg::Paste -> mgr.send_paste_raw; session.rs:498 send_paste_raw emits opener marker, chunked body (char-boundary safe), closer marker, NO Enter. Bracketed paste confirmed end-to-end.

falsifiable_tests.name: keystroke ordering guarantee (single consumer)
falsifiable_tests.hypothesis: If forwards still raced on per-key tokio::spawn, fast typing could reorder.
falsifiable_tests.command: read forwarder.rs:54-109 — verify exactly one tokio::spawn drains one mpsc FIFO and Key/Paste/session-switch flush pending Text first
falsifiable_tests.expected: one consumer task, FIFO channel, flush_text before any Key/Paste/different-session msg
falsifiable_tests.actual: spawn_forwarder spawns ONE task draining a single unbounded mpsc; Text coalesced only for the same session; flush_text (forwarder.rs:42) called before Key (line 92), Paste (line 100) and on session switch (line 85). Exactly one task reaches the transport => order guaranteed.

falsifiable_tests.name: pane_cache mutex lock-not-held-across-await
falsifiable_tests.hypothesis: If the async mutex were held across the get_session RPC await, callers would serialise / risk contention stalls (reintroducing lag).
falsifiable_tests.command: read session.rs:266-290 pane_for — verify the lock guard is dropped before get_session().await
falsifiable_tests.expected: inner lock scope for the hit-check, dropped, then RPC, then a fresh short lock for insert
falsifiable_tests.actual: pane_for takes the lock in an inner block for the hit check (returns clone on hit), drops it, awaits get_session OUTSIDE any lock, then re-locks briefly for entry().or_insert_with(). No await-under-lock; race resolves to equivalent panes. invalidate_pane (session.rs:288) drops the slot on kill/rename/stale.

falsifiable_tests.name: drain-loop starvation bound
falsifiable_tests.hypothesis: If the per-tick event drain had no wall-clock bound, a key/paste flood could starve redraw + preview (UI freeze).
falsifiable_tests.command: read main.rs:657-667 + 1181 — verify drain_budget (8ms) breaks the loop and first poll uses tick_rate, subsequent ZERO
falsifiable_tests.expected: first_iter timeout=tick_rate(16ms); subsequent ZERO; `if drain_start.elapsed() > drain_budget { break }`
falsifiable_tests.actual: drain_budget=8ms (main.rs:658); first_iter timeout=tick_rate else ZERO (660-665); budget check breaks the while after 8ms so redraw/preview/housekeeping always run. Hot-path Actions are non-blocking channel sends, so each drain iteration is fast.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: CLAIM vs REALITY: comment said the paste is forwarded 'as literal text ... One send_text_raw call', but the code dispatches Action::SendTextRawToSession -> ForwardMsg::Paste -> send_paste_raw (bracketed paste, no Enter). A future maintainer could 'simplify' the paste back to raw send_text and reintroduce the exact user-reported newline-submit bug.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix_applied: Rewrote the comment to state the real path: ForwardMsg::Paste -> send_paste_raw with bracketed-paste markers and no trailing Enter. Comment-only edit; build re-verified 0 errors.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: CLAIM vs REALITY: comment said 'the last writer winning' but entry().or_insert_with() is FIRST-writer-wins; each caller returns its own freshly-resolved pane regardless. Inaccurate concurrency documentation on a load-bearing path.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix_applied: Corrected the comment to describe first-to-re-lock winning the cache slot with every caller returning its own equivalent pane. Comment-only edit; build re-verified 0 errors.

issues_found_not_fixed.issue: send_paste_raw lacks the invalidate-on-stale single-retry that all sibling hot-path methods have (send_text_raw, send_key, resize_pane, capture_pane, capture_pane_with_cursor). If the cached pane is stale (session killed+recreated) at paste time and there is no pending text to flush first, the paste fails once.
issues_found_not_fixed.non_issue_justification: Not applied deliberately (surgical / do-no-harm). The gap self-heals: the forwarder calls flush_text (send_text_raw, which DOES retry+invalidate on stale) immediately before send_paste_raw, and the continuous preview refresh (capture_pane_with_cursor, which invalidates on stale) heals the cache within one ~30-80ms tick. The user-reported paste bug is the multiline auto-submit, which is fully fixed; the stale-pane edge requires a mid-paste session recreate (not the user's flow). Adding retry to a multi-write opener/body/closer sequence carries a small double-emit risk that outweighs the benefit on a live system. Documented for future hardening.

issues_found_not_fixed.location: crates/omega-cli/src/forwarder.rs:55 (mpsc::unbounded_channel) and the Action name SendTextRawToSession
issues_found_not_fixed.issue: (a) The forwarder channel is unbounded; a pathological producer (huge paste while the consumer blocks on a slow PTY write) could grow memory. (b) Action variant SendTextRawToSession is a misnomer now that it dispatches a bracketed Paste.
issues_found_not_fixed.non_issue_justification: (a) Bounded in practice by human input rate and Text coalescing; acceptable for an interactive TUI. (b) Renaming the variant touches input.rs + main.rs for a purely cosmetic gain on working code; left as-is to avoid scope creep — the misleading comment (the real hazard) is already corrected in FIX-001.

edge_cases.scenario: User pastes a 30-line block while the preview is scrolled up into history (follow_tail == false).
edge_cases.evidence_gathered: main.rs SendTextRawToSession handler calls app.scroll_preview_end() (preview_scroll=0, follow_tail=true) right after enqueueing the Paste, so the preview re-glues to the tail and the user sees the pasted block land. Consistent with the keystroke handlers.

edge_cases.scenario: User types 'a b c' fast — spaces are routed as Key 'Space' which forces a coalescing flush mid-word.
edge_cases.evidence_gathered: forwarder coalesces 'a' as pending Text, Key 'Space' flushes 'a' then sends Space, 'b' starts new pending Text, etc. Order a,space,b,space,c preserved; only a minor extra send per space, no reorder. Verified by reading forwarder.rs:82-104.

NEW_FINDINGS_THIS_RUN.note: The following findings were discovered in ui.rs (not in the prior audit scope) and in a deeper re-analysis of scroll behavior.

build_evidence.confirms: workspace still clean; prior fixes still compile

findings.issue: Box::leak in draw_telegram_setup_modal() — called every render tick while TelegramSetupUserId modal is visible. Each tick leaks ~100 bytes. At 60fps for 30 seconds on step 3: ~3600 × 100B ≈ 360KB non-reclaimable heap.
findings.falsifiable_test: grep -n 'Box::leak' crates/omega-tui/src/ui.rs → 1 match at line 105 in draw_telegram_setup_modal(). Function is called from draw() on every frame when input_mode matches TelegramSetupUserId.
findings.fix: Replace Box::leak with a owned String or restructure the match arm to hold the formatted string for the duration of the render call.

findings.issue: Scroll first-press no-op in tail mode. preview_max_scroll initializes to 0 and is set by the renderer (ui.rs:437) from preview_content.lines().count() - viewport_height. In tail mode, content is ~50 visible lines and viewport is ~50 rows → max_scroll = 0. First scroll_preview_up: preview_scroll = (0+3).min(0) = 0. preview_follow_tail flips to false, but scroll does not move. User sees no change. Second press (now with history content, max_scroll=950) actually scrolls. Double-press required to enter scrollback.
findings.falsifiable_test: grep -n 'preview_max_scroll' crates/omega-tui/src/app.rs → init value is 0 (line 718); .min(self.preview_max_scroll) clamp at line 888 produces 0 when max_scroll=0.
findings.fix: On the first scroll-up while in tail mode, skip the .min(preview_max_scroll) clamp and immediately set follow_tail=false with preview_scroll=lines. OR: initialize preview_max_scroll to u16::MAX until the first renderer tick sets the real value.

findings.issue: Dead statement with misleading comment: `(area.width as f32 * 0.75) as u16;` — the semicolon discards the value. Both if and else branches always return area.height.saturating_sub(2). The comment says '75% of area (detail panel) minus borders' suggesting the intent was a different value, but the actual code path produces the same thing as the if branch.
findings.falsifiable_test: grep -n 'area.width as f32' crates/omega-tui/src/ui.rs → 1 match at line 1352 inside an else branch with semicolon; dead code confirmed.
findings.fix: Remove the dead statement and its comment. The panel_height logic is already correct (area.height.saturating_sub(2) for both branches).

auto_done_confirmation.scope_question: Do any of the 6 scoped TUI files need changes for auto-done?
auto_done_confirmation.answer: No. Auto-done belongs in patrol.rs (detect 100% todos + idle → write DoneSignal). The 6 scoped files are TUI/session infrastructure — they do not interact with patrol or DoneSignal.
auto_done_confirmation.evidence: grep -rn 'DoneSignal\|todos_completed' crates/omega-tui/ → 0 matches. The feature audit (obs 45262) correctly identified patrol.rs:193 as the sole implementation point.
auto_done_confirmation.patrol_gap_confirmed: patrol.rs:193 has `todos_completed < todos_total` guard for stall detection; no branch for >= todos_total + idle = auto-done. This is a feature gap, not a regression from these TUI fixes.
